The front bumper coevr is cracked and displaced on the driver side, with the upper
radiator support bracket bent and the hood latch assembly deformed. The headlamp

speed, and nothing I observed points to earlier damage on this vehicle. The repair plan

recalibrates the sensor mounts. The labor hours on the estimate are consistent with
